events.title: Hashcash gains attention as a proof-of-work anti-spam system

research.summary: Back's formal Hashcash paper consolidated the proof-of-work system originally proposed in 1997.
research.significance: The 2002 paper became the standard published description of Hashcash and is directly relevant to Bitcoin's PoW lineage.
